similar_historical_incidents.past_root_cause: Desiccant dryer purge exhaust solenoid valve seat contaminated with particulate debris, preventing tight closure during compression cycle.
similar_historical_incidents.verified_action: Disassembled purge solenoid valve, cleaned brass seat, replaced internal Viton seal, and verified pressure drop below 0.05 bar.

similar_historical_incidents.past_root_cause: Pneumatic pilot actuator on shuttle valve Tower 2 seized due to moisture ingress in the pilot line.
similar_historical_incidents.verified_action: Rebuilt shuttle valve actuator, replaced desiccant bed in Tower 2 pre-filter, and calibrated switching timer.

recommended_diagnostic_procedures: 1. Depressurize unit and lock out electrical motor supply (LOTO protocol).
2. Inspect dryer purge silencer for continuous audible exhaust while compressor is in loaded state.
3. Measure purge line backpressure using calibrated test gauge at port M1 (must be < 0.05 bar when closed).
4. Verify solenoid coil energization with magnetic flux indicator.
5. Remove purge valve body and inspect Viton seat for particulate indentations or oil emulsion sludge.
6. Reassemble with new O-ring kit (Part #CAU-SK-44) and torque bonnet bolts to 18 Nm.
